name: Virot Maglan
description: The Cabal Patriarch, leader and founder of Dominaria's Cabal, whose touch decays everything.

description_citations.text: "Virot Maglan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The god Kuberr grants Virot Maglan's dreams, starting the Cabal.
timeline.quote: His dreams are granted by the god Kuberr

citation.text: "The Secrets of Magic", section "Family Man , by Scott McGough". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Virot Maglan founds the Cabal in the wake of the collapse of Suderbod, focused on commerce.
timeline.quote: The Cabal was founded by Virot Maglan in 4050 AR

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Foundation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer destroys Cabal City after the Patriarch's exile to Aphetto, which becomes the new center of the Cabal.
timeline.quote: the Patriarch's exile to Aphetto and Cabal City's subsequent destruction by Chainer

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Cities". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Virot Maglan pacts with Kuberr and founds the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Virot Maglan sealed a pact with the god Kuberr and gained the power to kill using touch

citation.text: "Cabal City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The reincarnated Kuberr takes over the Cabal after the Patriarch's death.
timeline.quote: The reincarnated Kuberr took over the Cabal after the Patriarch's death.

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Reign of Kuberr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Karona's War the Cabal is left with no leader and no god and is presumed defunct around 4500 AR.
timeline.quote: the Cabal was left with no leader and no god

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Reign of Kuberr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Virot Maglan brings his sister Vinyata to Docktown to demonstrate his deathtouch powers.
timeline.quote: brought his sister Vinyata Maglan to Docktown to offer her a demonstration

citation.text: "Docktown", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Virot and Vinyata kill everyone in the Ilyssa tavern except the owner, who begged for his life.
timeline.quote: he and Vinyata killed everyone there except a single except the tavern owner, who begged for his life

citation.text: "Docktown", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The tavern owner is spared if he gives up his Ilyssa name and obeys Virot, becoming the Cabal's first unofficial member.
timeline.quote: This unnamed tavern owner was thus the very first unofficial member of the Cabal

citation.text: "Docktown", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kuberr contacts Virot Maglan in a dream, granting death power for worship, seeding the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Kuberr contacted Virot Maglan in a dream and granted him the power of death in return for worship

citation.text: "Kuberr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Virot Maglan oversees the Rise of the Cabal and becomes the First, gaining a vastly extended lifespan and a touch that decays anything.
timeline.quote: Virot Maglan oversaw the Rise of the Cabal and became the First, its Patriarch.

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Battle for the Mirari the First is exiled to Aphetto after Laquatus gives Chainer his secret name.

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Chainer's death the First regains control of the Cabal from Aphetto and plans the Grand Coliseum.
timeline.quote: the First regained control over the Cabal based in Aphetto

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The First finds a form of love in Phage and puts her in charge of building the Grand Coliseum.
timeline.quote: He found a form of love in Phage

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After sending Phage to lead the Nightmare War, the First receives a vision from Kuberr that they belong together but she might kill him.
timeline.quote: he received a vision from Kuberr that they belonged together

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The First tries to assassinate Phage, but her pregnancy stays his hand; her son is the reborn god Kuberr.
timeline.quote: her revelation that she was pregnant stayed his hand

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The First, having lost his immortality by betraying Kuberr, tries again to kill Phage but Braids snaps him in half with a dementia creature.
timeline.quote: allowing Braids to intervene and snap him in half with a dementia creature

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
